messages:
emily: quick q — where do I look for canary-42 GPU health? need SM% heatmap, per-GPU memory, KV cache hit%, and batch-size distribution. also: what are the current alert thresholds for low SM% and high mem on canary pools? :eyes:

raj: GPU heatmap + per-gpu metrics -> Grafana panel: https://console.redwood.ai/d/gpu-health/gpu-pool-overview?pool=canary-42. heatmap there has SM% by minute. batch-size distro is on the same dashboard (bottom-left).

dmitri: if you want traces for slow tokens, use the traces UI and filter by alloc:canary-42 + span:kv-fetch. quick logs query (Loki):

```
{job="inference-logs"} |= "alloc=canary-42" | json | stats avg(gpu.sm_util) by gpu_id
```

that returns per-GPU SM% samples over the query window.

sarah: KV cache metrics live in per-model dashboards (model=redwood-1.2) — link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/model-insights/kvcache?model=redwood-1.2&pool=canary-42. look at `kv.hits_rate` and `kv.evictions` panels. evictions spike = bad for latency.

ops-bot: Alert summary for pool=canary-42:
- gpu_sm_low: triggers when 3/5m avg SM% < 12% on >50% GPUs in pool.
- gpu_mem_high: triggers when resident_bytes > 0.95 * gpu.mem_total for any GPU for >2m.
- kv_eviction_rate: triggers when evictions/s > 1.5 for 5m.

raj: If you want to tune, open Observability -> Alerts -> edit rule (you need infra-admin). For canary you can relax gpu_sm_low to 8% for short-lived tests. For production pools keep 12%.

emily: perfect, thanks. one follow-up: where can I see batch-size percentiles (p50/p95) over the last 6 hours?

dmitri: panel name "request.batch_size.percentiles" on the gpu-pool-overview dashboard. Grafana link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/gpu-health/gpu-pool-overview?view=batch-percentiles&pool=canary-42. or query Prometheus:

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_bucket{pool="canary-42"}[5m])) by (le))
```

sarah: FYI I added a short-run dashboard shortcut in the canary deployment PR description: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/inference/+/refs/heads/canary-42 — check the top-of-PR links. :white_check_mark:

emily: awesome, I'll audit the alerts and run a 30m load to confirm. pinging if I need infra-admin to change thresholds.

raj: 👍 let us know results in this thread.
